data.name: NIGHT RAIDER
data.detailed_description:
You stand alone against an endless tide of darkness. In this 3D top-down Roguelike survival shooter, wield glowing bla

des and devastating magic to carve a path through swarming monsters. Auto-aim keeps the pressure on—your job is to mov

e, dodge, and craft the ultimate build from over 20 upgradable skills. How long can you survive?

──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

About This Game

───────────────

Night falls, and the horde never ends. Your only weapons are a radiant sword, a battle axe, and the survival instincts

you sharpen with every wave.

Night Raider is a 3D top-down Vampire Survivors-inspired survival shooter. Built in Godot 4.5 with the Forward Plus re

nderer, every battle unfolds across detailed 3D arenas—brick floors, breakable barrels, and dynamic lighting that make

s each fight a test of both strategy and spectacle.

Auto-Fire, Focus on Tactics

───────────────────────────

Your character automatically locks onto and fires at the nearest threat. All you control is movement and decision-maki

ng. WASD to dodge, mouse to pick upgrades. Easy to learn, but mastery demands tactical thinking.

20+ Roguelike Skill Builds

──────────────────────────

Every level-up offers a random three-card choice to reshape your run:

• Barrage Branch: Multishot, Fan Spread, Giant Bullet, Double Strike—drown the horde in raw firepower.

• Elemental Destruction: Frost Bolts to slow, Burning Rounds to sear, Explosive Shells for screen-wide clears, and Tox

Clouds that eat away health over time.

• Precision Strikes: Homing bullets that never miss, Pierce rounds that tear through formations, Chain Lightning that

cs between foes, and Critical Hits that shake the camera.

• Survival Layers: Cell Regeneration for passive healing, Thorns Aura to punish attackers, Orbiting Shields for active

efense, and Vampiric Fangs that heal on every kill.

• Power Awakenings: Blood Frenzy, Recoil Burst, Devotion, Amulets of Strength—every pick redefines your playstyle.

A Bestiary of Threats

─────────────────────

Not all enemies charge blindly. You'll face:

• Goblins & War Chariots — endless melee fodder that tests your positioning

• Witches & Shooters — ranged threats that force you to keep moving

• Vampires & Spiders — fast assassins that punish slow reactions

• Giant Elites — scaled-up nightmares that appear as dynamic difficulty ramps up

Dynamic Difficulty & Polished Performance

─────────────────────────────────────────

Enemies don't just flood the screen—they get smarter, faster, and tougher over time. Smart distance culling and a 60-e

nemy cap keep the action smooth even at peak chaos. Rich audio feedback—gunfire, impact crunches, kill confirms, XP ch

imes, and looping footsteps—keeps you immersed without ear fatigue.

3D Visuals & Atmosphere

───────────────────────

Glowing weapons cut through the dark. Bullets and experience gems emit dynamic point lights that paint the battlefield

. Procedural brick shaders, PBR materials, and death dissolve animations built with Tweens add a layer of polish you c

an feel.

──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

Key Features

────────────

• Pure Survival Thrills: Auto-aim shooting with zero barrier to entry, yet build-crafting depth that lasts for hundred

of hours.

• 20+ Unique Skills: Four distinct branches—Barrage, Elemental, Survival, and Burst—so no two runs feel the same.

• 3D Top-Down Battlefields: Godot 4.5 Forward Plus rendering with refined lighting and dynamic VFX.

• Intelligent Difficulty Scaling: Enemies evolve over time rather than mindlessly stacking in number, creating a smoot

but escalating challenge curve.

• Diverse Monster Bestiary: Goblins, witches, war chariots, vampires, spiders, ranged shooters, and giant elites.

• Smooth Performance Optimization: Enemy cap and distance-based logic culling keep 60+ on-screen foes running buttery

ooth.

• Immersive Audio Design: Global audio cooldowns prevent spam, leaving only crisp, satisfying combat feedback.

• Full UI Suite: Main menu, in-game HUD, pause screen, upgrade panel, and results screen all included.

data.short_description: Survive endless dark monsters in this top-down 3D roguelike shooter. Use glowing swords and deadly magic to fight swarms. Auto-aim frees you to move and dodge. Upgrade over 20 skills to build your setup. How long can you live?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 / AMD Ryzen 5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 / AMD RX 560
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Vulkan 1.0
